scriptData.label: @effect.name
Roll to remove Stunned

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your unspeakably evil enemy rams his weapon into the many and vulnerable blood vessels where thigh meets abdomen, the area also known as your groin. Very bloody, very painful!

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (2) and @Condition[Stunned] (2). There is much wincing among the witnesses to your misfortune.
